messages:
Aisha (partnerships): quick sync — SignalSecure (HSM vendor) + NovaSI want a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement. timeline: target go‑live 2 weeks. need SSO/SCIM mapping, KMS/HSM onboarding steps, legal embargo, and a small integration test plan.
Sam (security): high level: we need FIPS cert check, attestation flow, and a signed key import API for their HSM. also KMS wrapping/unwrapping test vectors. I can draft the checklist.
Priya (SignalSecure): thanks — we have FIPS 140-3 and attestation doc. we expose a PKCS#11 endpoint and a REST wrapKey api at /v1/keys/wrap. happy to share test certs.
Jules (product): do we have a placeholder in the marketplace for the listing copy? marketing wants product bullets + screenshots. also: can we do canary routing for the first week?
Eli (solutions-eng): for the SI flow, NovaSI wants SCIM provisioning + SSO. recommend SCIM v2 mapping: displayName -> name.formatted, emails[0].value -> userName, groups -> entitlements. quick example:```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jill","familyName":"Smith","formatted":"Jill Smith"}
}```
Aisha (partnerships): perfect — include that mapping in the partner playbook.
Sam (security): add rotation policy: HSM keys must support in-place rotate and we need a fallback to wrapped KMS key in Redwood if attestation fails. also ensure SCIM group sync uses incremental delta to avoid full imports.
Priya (SignalSecure): we can support key rotation via our admin API. sample curl for wrap/unwarp test:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.signalsecure.example.com/v1/keys/wrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"key_id":"hk-123","plaintext":"..."}'
```
Marco (legal): embargo: no public announcement before 2024-06-15 17:00 PT. need NDA amendment for co-marketing and a joint statement approval flow (partners => Redwood => legal signoff). I'll drop a one‑pager.
Jules (product): rollout plan proposal: week0 internal preview (partner + SEs), week1 marketplace soft launch (limited accounts), week2 full announcement + docs + tutorials. need canary policy and metrics to watch: 95p latency, error rate, onboarding success rate.
Eli (solutions-eng): on testing: we'll need a small harness that runs: SCIM provisioning, SSO login, wrap/unwrap roundtrip, and sample token signing/attestation. I can make a repo and invite NovaSI and SignalSecure.
Aisha (partnerships): action items: @Sam draft security checklist by EOD Thur; @Marco draft NDA addendum + approval flow by Mon; @Eli create test harness repo + invite partners; @Priya send FIPS + attestation certs; @Jules create marketplace placeholder + marketing draft.
Priya (SignalSecure): sending certs now (link: https://files.signalsecure.example.com/redwood/hsm-certs). will join test harness next Tue.
deploy-bot: Release note: marketplace-placeholder branch created: partners/hsm-signalsecure. CI passed.
Sam (security): thumbs up. will hook up KMS key policies and provide test vectors.
Marco (legal): one quick ask — any customer logos in the joint blurb? need written approvals ahead of announcement.
Jules (product): good point — marketing, please confirm logo permissions.
Aisha (partnerships): thanks everyone — next sync Friday 9am PT. I'll ping a calendar invite and a short agenda. :calendar:
